overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in a suburban Philadelphia district that leans Democratic by eight points. She enters with a commanding financial position, having raised about $1.37 million and holding $1.18 million on hand, while Republican challenger Aurora Stuski has raised under $9,000. No outside groups are spending against Dean, and prediction markets give her roughly a 97 percent chance of winning.

With no public polls or expert ratings available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided money gap. All of these point to a comfortable Dean victory, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
